text.v: Rain on the glass. MAREN stands over a chart table, a brass LAMP flickering beside her. ELIAS waits in the doorway, coat still dripping.
We ride at dawn and we do not look back.vvh
Sleep is for people with somewhere to return to.
Grey light. A rusted CRANE leans over the water. ELIAS waits with two canvas BAGS at his feet.
The engine noise is constant. MAREN holds the wheel. ELIAS studies the chart.
Three days, if the weather holds.
